prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single private character reference image for a playful original AI animated short and image-to-video identity reference. Premium charming original 3D animated film character design, tactile groomed fur, softly rounded forms, expressive appealing face, subtle comic personality, polished studio render, soft broad key light and gentle rim light. Square composition, one character only, full body from ears to feet entirely visible, front-facing relaxed symmetrical stance, arms slightly away from body, tail clearly visible at side, camera at character eye level, no perspective distortion. Character occupies about 78 percent of image height and stays within the central 50 percent of image width so it can also be cropped vertically. Plain warm light-gray seamless studio background with only a soft contact shadow. No scene, props, accessories, second character, text, name label, logo, watermark, collage, panels, turnaround sheet or duplicate limbs. This is a lovable anthropomorphic cat with cat paws, not human hands. Make it funny through expression, not busy objects. Subject: MILO, an original small young-adult male orange anthropomorphic tabby cat, with warm ginger fur, subtle darker ginger stripes, cream muzzle and chin, amber eyes, small pink nose, fluffy cheek fur and a mischievous little upward hair tuft. He wears a PLAIN vivid medium-blue pullover hoodie, hood resting down, without drawstrings, pockets, logos or patterns, no trousers and no shoes. His natural orange fur legs and paws are visible. Cheerful curious overconfident grin, one eyebrow slightly raised, bright eyes; the expression says he has just had a very silly idea. Stable simple outfit and readable silhouette. Do not give him an apron.
